final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT c.district_id AS d, di.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS n FROM client c JOIN district di ON di.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY c.district_id, di.A3), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.d, s1.region, s1.n, CAST(s1.n AS REAL) / s2.total AS share FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL) SELECT region, AVG(n), AVG(share) FROM s3 GROUP BY region
